_method: Second recording (2026-10-09 3:49 AM) replaces the first. Phrase start/end = Silero VAD (min_silence 0.25 s, threshold 0.5), measured; vad_segments are the VAD speech segments inside a phrase (the mouth closes in the gaps between them). 27 segments map onto the 25 script phrases: 5, 13 and 18 span two segments, 10 and 11 are split at a measured pause. screen_text = words heard in this recording, checked by forced-choice scoring with two models (analysis/asr_candidates.json, asr_score.json); phrases whose wording the models do not settle keep the script text and are open questions. Word-level timing NOT measured. vad_enhanced = Silero VAD re-run on the enhanced file; its longer ends (up to +0.39 s at 40.93, 46.25) are room noise lifted by the gain (−62 dBFS in the original), so the mouth uses vad_segments.
